name: mabl
bestFor: Low-code, self-healing end-to-end test automation across web, mobile, and API
description: An AI-native test automation platform that authors and auto-heals UI, API, accessibility, and performance tests as the application under test changes, cutting flaky-test maintenance.

freeTier.limits: 14-day free trial; no persistent free tier

paidTier.notes: No public list price — custom quotes, starting from 500 cloud-run credits per month (local and CI runs are unlimited). Third-party contract data (Vendr and others) estimates Starter plans around $450–$600/month and Growth-tier deployments $1,200–$3,000/month on annual contracts — a market-observed range, not an official price.

name: Katalon Platform
bestFor: A full test automation platform with a genuinely free desktop tool to start from
description: An AI-assisted test automation platform (Katalon Studio plus a cloud True Platform) covering web, mobile, API, and desktop testing, with a permanently free local/manual tier.

freeTier.limits: Free plan: local authoring, record-and-playback, and local execution, plus a 30-day trial of paid features

paidTier.notes: Professional lists at $2,199/seat/year (~$183/seat/month), billed annually; a limited-time 55% discount on the first 3 seats ($1,000/seat/year) ends Oct 31, 2026. Headless/CI execution (Runtime Engine) and TestCloud execution are separate add-ons, now quoted by sales. Enterprise is custom.

name: Applitools
bestFor: AI-powered visual regression testing that catches pixel-level UI bugs functional tests miss
description: Visual AI testing that compares rendered UI screenshots across browsers and devices, using computer vision to flag real visual regressions while ignoring rendering noise.

freeTier.limits: No persistent free tier any more — free trial only (registration required, no card)

paidTier.notes: Starter is $667/month (paid annually), including 100,000 component checkpoints or 1,000 page checkpoints. Professional (from 150 active pages / 1,500 components, unlimited executions) and Enterprise (from 350 active pages / 1,500 components) are custom-quoted.

name: TestMu AI (KaneAI)
bestFor: Agentic AI test authoring — describe a test in plain English and an AI agent writes, runs, and heals it
description: KaneAI is an agentic AI QE platform (formerly LambdaTest, rebranded to TestMu AI in January 2026) that authors multi-language test scripts from natural-language intent, auto-heals broken tests, and includes cloud execution minutes on its Pro and Max plans.

freeTier.limits: A $0 'Free Forever' plan is listed; its credit and execution allowances aren't stated

paidTier.notes: Priced per agent/month on credit plans, not per seat: Starter $19/agent/mo ($17 billed annually, 2,000 credits, local Kane CLI authoring only, no HyperExecute minutes), Pro $99/agent/mo ($89 annually, 12,000 credits, cloud web authoring, 100 HyperExecute execution minutes/month), Max $199/agent/mo ($179 annually, 25,000 credits, cloud web + mobile authoring, 300 HyperExecute execution minutes/month). Each agent includes one Test Manager seat. Enterprise is custom.

name: Tricentis Testim
bestFor: AI-stabilized test automation for teams already standardized on the Tricentis enterprise testing platform
description: An AI-powered web test automation tool (Testim, acquired by Tricentis in 2022) that uses machine learning to identify UI elements and keep tests passing through app changes, sold through Tricentis's enterprise, quote-only sales motion.

freeTier.limits: No free tier; request-a-demo sales process only

paidTier.notes: No published pricing — request-only, annual contracts. Industry-reported figures: small teams (3-5 engineers) around $10,000-$20,000/year, mid-market contracts $20,000-$50,000+/year, scaling with team size and run volume — not official figures.
